reviews.x: The brush itself is really nice and feels high-quality. But the claim that it is "anti-static" is definitely false. One brush through non-tangled, dry hair makes my hair a static puff. That's primarily why I purchased the brush and am definitely disappointed in that aspect. I can't really use it and it was basically a waste of money, but I am still giving it 3 stars for the quality and feel of the brush itself.

I love the bamboo brush.  Unlike plastic or synthetic brushes it does not create static in my hair, and it glides through without pulling out the hair but detangles it esily instead.  And Bamboo is such a lovely renewable product to make brushes from.  Get one for the home and one for your purse. Not pulling wads of hair out of my brush each morning any more.  And no dreaded static...well worth it.

reviews.t: they feel like a scalp masage
reviews.x: The bristles are a little more pointy than most brushes, but they don't hurt, they feel like a scalp masage! It doesn't eliminate static, but it definitely cuts it down a bit (It's just a brush, its not magic). It would easily be 5 stars but the handle is so thin and a little sharp on the edges which is a little uncomfortable in my hand, and I have pretty small hands. If you had large hands this could be a problem. Overall I love it though.

reviews.t: The whole reason I bought this is because it said ...
reviews.x: The whole reason I bought this is because it said "anti-static" and this is not true at all! The very first time I used the brush there was static. I had less static from my $3 Wal-Mart plastic brush.

reviews.t: Great beard brush but durabilty is an issue.
reviews.x: I bought this as a beard brush and it's great. Goes through my beard easy without pulling and the bristles feel great on the skin under my beard.  Update after a year, dropped from 5 to 3 stars...Loved it at first, but as time has passed the tines(?) have periodically pushed through into the brush. The holes in the rubber fatigue and the tines fall inside and there's a significant open spot in the middle of the brush. reviews.t: Be gentle when you use it.
reviews.x: Brushing with wood is supposed to be better for your hair, but be warned, the bristles in a wood brush don't give as much as plastic or boar bristle. They don't bend at all so it's easy to snap off strands of your hair on a snag if you don't brush carefully. Also, hair can get wrapped around the base of the bristles where they stick in the pad and are a pain to clean out. I ended up using my sandalwood wide tooth comb more often after all.

Yes, it really does dramatically decrease static in your hair.  Static has always been a major problem for me and this has eliminated the problem.  And it doesn't break the hair as other brushes can do.  Considering a second one.  LOVE IT!

I really like this brush, even after 2 years.  It is comfortable to use and clean.  It does help eliminate static.  The best part is how easy it is to clean.  I had given up buying good brushes and purchased dollar store brushed because my curly hair was horrible to try and clean out of a brush and I had to throw them away when they became gross.  I even ruined a brush cleaner trying to keep one clean.  This one cleans quickly and easily as it doesn't have the nubs at the top that hold the hair

reviews.t: Just as good as a tangleteezer
reviews.x: I had one of those tangleteezer (I swear that's how it was spelled) for my thick, wavy hair, and it worked great. After awhile it got a bit mucky and I wasn't digging the plastic so I heard about these from some YouTube chick and honestly... it works just as well, if not better. For a brush, I'm pretty pleased.

reviews.t: Hard to clean and hard to keep clean.
reviews.x: Wanted a brush that would be nicer on the hair and easier to clean, this one is still not the one! Very hard to clean as the bristles are hard and won't move at all and catches dust VERY easily (after one use, even not wet nor left on the counter, dust just goes all over the roots of the bristles)

I will never buy another brush again, I hope that I can find these bamboo hair brushes again when I need another. I love how it makes my hair soft and I don’t worry about my hair getting matted and having to cut my hair out of a brush. This bamboo brush takes away every tangle easily.

Missing a bristle already when shipped.  Was going to use for first time when I saw this. This is my second disaster trying to replace a bamboo brush that I got elsewhere but left along my travels. That one hadn't lost any bristles after a year. Returning this one.

I've had this brush for over 6 months and am very satisfied. I had been using the wet brush but the little ends of the bristles would fall off and the bristles would poke my head uncomfortably. This brush is very comfortable on my scalp. It is also lightweight.

reviews.t: I love bamboo but this was not solid enough in the ...
reviews.x: Maybe I should have just bought a larger brush for my very long thick hair, but after two weeks of using this brush, a few bristles came off.  I love bamboo but this was not solid enough in the bristle area.

reviews.t: a really good brush, however i wish it was a bit ...
reviews.x: a really good brush, however i wish it was a bit larger its kind off narrow and small for the amount of hair i have. but i really like that it does not tug on my hair.
I bought this for our cat we have another one for the other cat and he loves it. Glides through their fur easily and the cats love it.

My daughter has curly hair that can get snarled easily.  This brush is exactly what we needed!!!
Love this brush as it goes easily through my hair without tugging or pulling.

reviews.t: Does Not Reduce Static As Claimed

I have thick ,very long hair and it is hard to find a brush. The kind of brush I used for years is not sold in any local stores. I needed a new one desperately, so I gave this kind a try I really love it!! It detangles without pulling out a lot of hair, and does not static my hair. So glad I found this. Ty . This was original review then I cleaned it about 2 weeks later and the paddle broke in two?!  So that was that . What a waste of money! The Dollar store look alike lasted longer!

I love this brush! Tired of the old metal spike brushes I thought I would try this bamboo one. I have long thick hair and it does a great job of smoothing it, plus if you want a good scalp message just press it in a little harder and get some circulation going on your scalp. I just got it so I don;t know it will hold up, but so far so good.

claims.text: Many reviewers say the brush reduces or eliminates static, though a notable minority report it does not live up to the anti-static claim.
Reviewers frequently praise how easily it detangles and glides through hair without pulling or breaking strands.
Several reviewers report durability problems, including bristles coming loose, pushing through, or missing on arrival.
Some reviewers find the bristles stiff and hard to clean, with hair and dust getting caught in the base.
Reviewers commonly describe the bristles as comfortable on the scalp, with some comparing it to a scalp massage.
